scope_note: Library-tier KeepAlive state-machine model for decoder-backed stateful fuzzing. It covers request/response and done edges only; it does not claim live timer, retry, or eviction semantics.

message.name: keepalive-cookie-7
message.notes: A KeepAlive request enters the modeled await-response state.

message.name: keepalive-response-cookie-7
message.notes: A matching response returns the model to idle.

message.name: keepalive-cookie-max
message.notes: A max-cookie KeepAlive request enters the modeled await-response state.

message.name: keepalive-response-cookie-zero
message.notes: A valid KeepAlive response returns the model to idle.
